Title: promotions.fyi: Insights about performance review and promotion, per company | Product Hunt
# promotions.fyi. ## Insights about performance review and promotion, per company. I just launched promotions.fyi: company-specific guides with vetted insights about performance review and promotion. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for promotions.fyi. For the past 2 years, we've been obsessed with a simple question: **how can we accelerate career growth for software engineers?** We’ve talked to hundreds of engineers directly while building Taro, and we observed the same confusion repeatedly: *how do I get to the next level?* So, we started aggregating performance review and promotion data with promotions.fyi: The waitlist is open now, and we'll be live in early April for all signed up users. We’re hard at work to make this jam-packed with value: 🧐 We’ll cover the basics: when performance review happens, rating breakdowns at each level, and the promotion process 💪🏽 We’ll also share insights for each company, with advice from engineers at various levels I’m very excited that we nabbed this domain 😊 If you want to contribute details or tips about performance review from companies you've worked at, shoot me a message! We're excited to answer questions and hear your feedback. We're going to make it open for everyone. Hey everyone, I'm one of the cofounders behind this product, and I have a story to share on why we're building promotions.fyi. I joined Meta back in 2017 as an E4, which is a mid-level engineer. About a month into the job, I found an internal post asking if it was true that you needed to get promoted from E4 to E5 (which is senior) in 3 years or get fired. At Meta, Junior engineers [E3] need to get promoted to mid-level [E4] in 2 years and then progress from E4 to E5 in 2.75 years. My recruiter and the rest of my interview panel didn't tell me this. This is the information we want to make accessible to the world with promotions.fyi. There's all this more hidden institutional knowledge about what it actually takes to succeed at these top companies, which can also really affect whether or not you join it to begin with. We're excited to work with all of you to make that happen.

Title: Effy AI: AI-powered 360 feedback and performance review software | Product Hunt
# Effy AI. ## AI-powered 360 feedback and performance review software. Effy AI provides the fastest experience in conducting 360 reviews for employees with ready-to-use templates and AI-generated reports. It fits best companies that are just starting to build review processes and those that conduct reviews occasionally. Review feedback on Effy AI is sparse and mostly positive, but narrow. One user liked the core idea and found the social proof on the site engaging, suggesting the product feels relevant for teams dealing with performance reviews. The only clear criticism is about presentation rather than use: the reviewer felt the website could be simpler, with fewer distractions and a clearer visual focus. I think this is a great tool that will help facilitate meaningful conversations as people get ramped up to a company and the workflow. Slack integrations are also a powerful way to hold teammates accountable for their company and professional development, so awesome Effy will be able to leverage that! 🚀 I especially like how Effy is developed with employees in mind, allowing them to submit reviews even through Slack. I see that this tool gives employees greater flexibility and convenience, making it easier for them to participate in the review process and provide comments.
